title: Bdellium and onyx — photos of the two stones
summary: Two captioned photographs: bdellium (dark brown lumps of resin) on the left and onyx (polished oval red-and-white banded stones) on the right.

pictures.description: Close-up photo of a small pile of dark brown to black, lumpy, crusty chunks of aromatic gum resin, with one translucent amber-coloured piece in the middle, resting on a pale cloth.
Two rows of polished oval stones in glossy red-brown with white and cream wavy bands, laid side by side on a white background.
